filename.Description: Path of the scan file, relative to the session directory.

age_acq_time.Description: Local clock time-of-day at which the scan was acquired (HH:MM:SS). This is the non-standard column name used by the original recording lab; per BIDS, the canonical column for full ISO 8601 acquisition timestamps is `acq_time`, but only the time-of-day portion is recorded here.
